## go-see 90s shot map

Klein identity still: Queue this graph. SaveImage prefix `ez_gosee_identity`.
Then retarget **bridge-wan-lab-example** (silent draft) and **bridge-ltx-lab-example** (print + world audio).

18 × 120 frames @ 24 fps = 90.00s. Last frame of shot N is LoadImage of shot N+1.
Concat: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film go-see --yes`

Do not Queue a 90s denoise in one graph. US-safe local pack only. No score (breath and world only).

**Identity look:** First-person POV travel still: olive windbreaker, worn black gloves, hands in frame, photoreal dawn light, no logos, no violence, no text. Identity lock for the whole short.

- Motion: Shot 1 of 18, beat 1 enter. First-person travel camera. Olive windbreaker, worn black gloves; hands plant on wet tar. Dawn rooftop, city still sleeping, pigeon scatter. Vault the parapet. Parkour is transportation. No logos, no violence.
- Audio: Breath close to the lens, wind in the hood, tar grit. No score, no music, no licensed songs.

- Motion: Shot 2 of 18, beat 1 traverse. Same olive windbreaker and gloves. Barrel-roll through open sky between rooftops. Hands briefly out of frame then back. Continuous dawn light.
- Audio: Wind roar, fabric snap, breath. No score.

- LoadImage: `ez_gosee_b1_s2_last`

- Audio: Tar grit, roll, breath. No score.

- LoadImage: `ez_gosee_b1_s3_last`

- Motion: Shot 4 of 18, beat 2 enter. Ladder drop down the warehouse wall. Gloves on rungs. First-person.
- Audio: Metal rungs, breath. No score.

- LoadImage: `ez_gosee_b2_s1_last`
- VHS Wan: `ez_gosee_b2_s2_wan_video` · VHS LTX: `ez_gosee_b2_s2_ltx_video` · last: `ez_gosee_b2_s2_last`
- Motion: Shot 5 of 18, beat 2 traverse. Market alley at street level. Vault a wooden pallet, duck under a canvas awning. Hands plant on pallet then awning pole. No brand names.
- Audio: Canvas slap, distant market chatter without brand names, breath. No score.

- LoadImage: `ez_gosee_b2_s2_last`
- VHS Wan: `ez_gosee_b2_s3_wan_video` · VHS LTX: `ez_gosee_b2_s3_ltx_video` · last: `ez_gosee_b2_s3_last`
- Motion: Shot 6 of 18, beat 2 exit. Run out toward a river. Location change is the camera motion. Gloves in frame.
- Audio: Footfalls, open air, breath. No score.

- Audio: Water, splash, breath. No score.

- LoadImage: `ez_gosee_b3_s1_last`
- VHS Wan: `ez_gosee_b3_s2_wan_video` · VHS LTX: `ez_gosee_b3_s2_ltx_video` · last: `ez_gosee_b3_s2_last`
- Motion: Shot 8 of 18, beat 3 traverse. Through a stone bridge arch. Hands on wet rock.
- Audio: Water under the arch, breath. No score.

- LoadImage: `ez_gosee_b3_s2_last`

- Motion: Shot 9 of 18, beat 3 exit. Beech forest creek jump. Hands on a low branch. Parkour as travel.
- Audio: Beech leaves, creek, breath. No score, no violence.

- LoadImage: `ez_gosee_b3_s3_last`

- Motion: Shot 12 of 18, beat 4 exit. Out onto a headland with a generic white lighthouse — no logos, no real place name. Windbreaker snaps in sea wind.
- Audio: Surf, gulls, breath, fabric. No score.

- LoadImage: `ez_gosee_b4_s3_last`

- Motion: Shot 14 of 18, beat 5 traverse. Squeeze through a gap in a dry-stone wall. Hands on the wall stones.

- LoadImage: `ez_gosee_b5_s2_last`

- Motion: Shot 16 of 18, beat 6 enter. Ridge. Both worn-black-gloved hands on a weathered wooden rail. First-person.
- Audio: Rail creak, distant wind, breath. No score.

### b6 s2 `ez_gosee_b6_s2`
- LoadImage: `ez_gosee_b6_s1_last`
- VHS Wan: `ez_gosee_b6_s2_wan_video` · VHS LTX: `ez_gosee_b6_s2_ltx_video` · last: `ez_gosee_b6_s2_last`
- Motion: Shot 17 of 18, beat 6 traverse. Look along the ridge. Hold identity: olive windbreaker, gloves on the rail.
- Audio: Wind, breath. No score.

### b6 s3 `ez_gosee_b6_s3`
- LoadImage: `ez_gosee_b6_s2_last`
- VHS Wan: `ez_gosee_b6_s3_wan_video` · VHS LTX: `ez_gosee_b6_s3_ltx_video` · last: `ez_gosee_b6_s3_last`
- Motion: Shot 18 of 18, beat 6 exit. A quiet, short laugh. Hold. End still.
- Audio: Only breath, a creak of the rail, and distant wind. No score.
